      "explanation":"stolen_card",
      "likelihood":"high",
      "reasoning":"The issuing-country mismatch and failed address verification meet R03. Failed issuer authentication or identity verification materially strengthens unauthorized-use concerns, although the packet does not identify which component failed."

    {
      "explanation":"legitimate_customer",
      "likelihood":"low",
      "reasoning":"A longstanding card and device, with home delivery, support a legitimate customer using a foreign-issued card with an address mismatch. Those facts do not overcome the failed identity check under policy."

  "next_check":"none",
  "memo":"R03 establishes the Card family through issuing-country mismatch and failed AVS. No Account access, Velocity or Linkage condition holds; no Context rule holds. Household exceptions are unnecessary, and no earlier outcome settles this order. The applicable table row is §6.6(b), overridden by the failed id_check under §5.3(b): decline is standard, and escalation is prohibited without Linkage. A legitimate foreign-issued-card purchase remains plausible given the longstanding card and device and home delivery, but verification failure decides the recommendation. The order has shipped, so decline blocks the account without preventing the fulfilled-order loss. No further check is needed."
